title: Business rules and decisions
explain: Rules change faster than process graphs. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Business rules and decisions" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Business rules and decisions, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Business rules and decisions without a failure story
howToApply: Use Business rules and decisions explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Business rules and decisions” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Business → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Business rules and decisions” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Business rules and decisions” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Business rules and decisions”.
